dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000qbfv](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000qbfv) Magnitude 5.6 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Jul 08 2025 5km SW of Villa Nueva City. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 14.4995 longitude -90.6206. It impacted 1350834 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
